title: ElectionWatch State Snapshot
description: Per-state snapshot (state_S22.json etc.) with constituency-level detail. Consumed by /state/[code] pages.

as_of.description: ISO-8601 timestamp (with IST offset +05:30) of the last scraper write for this state.

constituencies.description: One entry per assembly constituency in this state, ordered by ac_no ascending.

ac_no.description: ECI assembly constituency number within the state.

leading_candidate.description: Name of the candidate currently leading. Null if counting not started.

leading_party.description: Party code of the leading candidate. Null if counting not started.

leading_margin.description: Vote margin over the trailing candidate. Null if counting not started.

rounds_completed.description: EVM counting rounds completed so far.

rounds_total.description: Total EVM counting rounds for this constituency.

status.description: pending=not started; counting=rounds in progress; leading=party ahead; declared=result final.

winner.description: Present only when status=declared. Winning candidate name.

winner_party.description: Present only when status=declared. Winning party code.

final_margin.description: Present only when status=declared. Final winning margin.

last_change_ts.description: Timestamp when this row last changed in the scraper diff.
